notes.title: v1.0.0 Release!
notes.content:
Features

 Final gameplay areas are unlocked! Two new regions to explore: Mystic Mountains and Battlegrounds
 New Cinematics!
 New minimalist combat UI
 Arrows and other status effects now only show when hovering relevant tiles (can be toggled in Settings to always show)
 Better indications of damage received when using spells
 Gameplay options now include a Skip Story / Speed Run setting, which bypasses speech events and other cinematics
 New Staff Flourish and Technique Options
 40 Steam achievements


Improvements

 New Loading Screens
 Various performance improvements
 Codex pages now have variable instructions based on virtual cursor vs 'speed input' for keyboard commands
 Tiles being overwatched now just show the overwatch icon and not the dmg amount
 Turned off (by default) the anti-magic glow on anti-magic tiles. Enemies that radiate anti-magic dynamically will continue to use the glow effect. Gameplay toggles now include an option to turn on the extra warning visuals for anti-magic zones
 Updated credits art and content


Bug fixes

 Defeating an enemy with a push or toss now properly increments the 'Defeat X opponents' objective
 Numerous typo fixes in item descriptions, loading screens, and mission texts
 Ice cracking sounds no longer play when throwing enemies on to sky tiles
 Water tiles frozen-then-re-broken now use correct background art
 Doorman retaliation attack tracks player correctly and doesn't trigger if Doorman is prone
 Defensive Casting now raises defenses sooner when using two-input spells (magic throw/smash, mind control) so that hero is defending BEFORE retaliation strike or exploding plague demons trigger damage
 Doorman no longer momentarily appears knocked out and standing when enraged
 Flourish Staff attacks that beat defenses no longer hurt certain unstoppable enemies
 Score scrolling looping bug fixed
 Fix for some audio looping issues when undoing quickly or toggling spells rapidly between turns
 Adding some codex entry events to tutorial levels that were missing them
 Fixed double-scoring of pitfalls
 Flying opponents knocked prone when hovering over a short obstacle now take additional damage instead of being knocked prone
 Adding the 'prone over short obstacle' details to the expanded info of a codex page and practice map for Flying Opponents
 Fixed a bug where the player's preview told them they could hit a blocking enemy with a slash that ended behind their shield arc
 Points for taking no damage should no longer appear on the score screen (or factor into renown rewards) when you choose to quit a level
 Mousing over obstacles and pits within your move range have slightly more helpful tooltip descriptors that mention if the obstacle is short and or breakable/damaged
 Adjusted map completion percentage seen on the main menu/save profile selection screen so that it should no longer exceed 100
 Move Variety cheat sheet widened a bit so that 'Improbable Boomerang' doesn't stomp into the wrong column
 Random subtitles on title screen should no longer run over the edge of the screen.
 Mission selector slide out now shows a scroll bar if description text would stretch the screen past a certain point
 If you enter the Campfire from a sub-region the back button in the Campfire should now take you back
 Technique tiles should no longer show their 'about to be relevant' glow effect if you have the settings menu, codex pages, feedback widget, or any other modal interface on top of the battleboard
 Fixed a flicker that occurs after some certain pushes animations
 Fixed various edge cases with the frozen lake
 Fixed Arena Endurance Match high scores not posting in the selection screen
 Fixing overlapping purchase flair vfx in Stores
 Minimizing selection box overlap on mousing over / keyboard navigating across tavern speakers
 Adding tooltip when mousing over (or keyboard focusing) tower floors on the right-hand side floor listing that explains the two mission objectives
 Fixed the Disarm Trap technique to trigger if you step into a charge that finishes off an enemy and overtakes their trapped tile
 Fixes for the 'fail path' through the Blighted Trail (that is, failing each mission should not longer result in progression confusion/blockage)
 Fixed an issue with sounds sometimes looping after using the Undo option.
 Fixing an issue with exploding enemies thrown into a pit with Fall Upwards not falling into a pit properly a related issue with Spring Step causing brambles to appear on pit/sky tiles; any brambles created now spawn only on ground
 Fix fullscreen mode

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.2.12
notes.content:
Features

 Introducing a new adventure area: The Demonic Wastelands! Test your wits against a demonic host of tenacious opponents that use a dastardly mix of brute force and swift maneuvering. Explore four new missions full of frenetic battles and challenging bonus objectives.


Improvements

 Updated Codex pages for content/clarity
 New animations for falling into Pit/Water
 For missions where victory is something other than “Defeat All Opponents” the Mastery Objective for that level will now say what is required to win the Complete Adventure objective.


Balance

 Increasing power of Retaliatory Strike, Aura of Growth, and Bewildering Motion
 Remapping Technique Requirements – if you’ve been playing the game you might have a Technique equipped that (as of this updated) you shouldn’t normally have unlocked. If this is the case, once you unequip that Technique, it will be locked again, so feel free to enjoy an Early Access exploit by keeping that Technique equipped!
 Remapping of Technique Unlocks to get a better distribution of rewards across doing missions and winning arena trophies
 Endurance Matches now include some new guest stars from the Demonic Wasteland region.


Bugfixes

 Fixed some issues with enemies being knocked out of bounds or causing collisions after being defeated.
 Dodging and Parrying enemies no longer play Dodge/Parry animations when being shoved around by other enemies to prevent flickering between animations
 Fixed a bug that caused Mind Control to work on certain immune to magic enemies
 When spawning new flying enemies, new flying enemies can spawn over pits and short obstacles (unlike non-flying enemies) but don't spawn over tall obstacles
 Enemies should no longer step onto each other and get ‘stacked’ in cases of extreme traffic jams.
 Enemies with 2 or more hp that were already prone and then moved into a pit (or pushed/tossed with the Upending Throw Technique) no longer double-score the Pit event
 Fixed an issue where Defending against a Fast enemy when Winding Down wasn't keeping your streak alive like it should have.
 Fixed an issue where the about-to-lose-momentum warning wasn't showing if you opened turn 1 with a perfect defense and then spent your first momentum action doing something that should put you in the Winding Down state.
 Various typo fixes.
 Fixed an issue with Training Golems flashing red when falling into a pit or taking lots of damage in one hit.
 Breaking through ice now removes ground hazards that were present on the tile before the ice shatters.
 Fix for determining the player's position when exploding enemies detonate after overtake-and-throw situations; Player should now be correctly hit when it seems like they ought to be hit by popping plague demon and are 'safe' when they ought to have been tossed clear of the hero.

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.2.8
notes.content:
Improvements

 Added a "Center On Hero" button that lives between Undo and Flourish and it centers the camera on the hero
 Enabled cross-platform cloud saves
 Defending sound effects now play when player defends
 More animated scenery VFX in Blighted Trail levels

 Equipping/Unequipping techniques now uses the StatPlus/StatMinus sound
 Equipping a spell now makes a bespoke sound per spell instead of one generic sound. Likewise, changing staff now uses flourish sound of your new staff
 Tower Lobby now has two sizes of animating torch flames in the various braziers
 Improved art for Blighted Trail, Bandit Hills, and Tower
 Dryad parry and block animations
 Necropolis Slasher speech art for threat/defeated poses added to Necropolis speech events
 Campfire submenus now have roll-over sound for when you roll-over/tab-select the campfire for techniques, the meditating Kalresh for stats, etc.
 Necromancers now use charge-up sounds at the start of their attack sequence, new sound) then a launch sound when the projectile fires, new sound), and lastly a projectile-explodes-into-hazard when projectile reaches on destination tile.
 Feedback widget has additional text about contact info


Balance

 Adjusted Battleground mastery objectives.
 Familiar Strike now does 10 points instead of 5.
 Confounding Staff's directed flourish is now unstoppable (that is, avoids parry/bock/dodge) on all strikes instead of just the opener. This makes it more reliably evade opponent defenses as advertised.
 Lightning Staff's directed flourish now does 3 damage on the target immediately next to you, 2 damage on the opponents two tile away, and then 1 damage beyond that
 Lighting Staff directed and whirlwind flourish attacks now evade Dodge/Parry


Bugfixes

 Updates/fixes to store text and item purchase/upgrade responses
 Fixing a bug with "lost a tutorial speech" looping forever
 Fixing some bugs with KO-to-explode logic
 Enemy magical attacks now play "magic" sound instead of "bow and arrow" sound
 Enemies being pushed/forced to move into a magic hazard play "magic damage" sound instead of "player hurt" sound
 Shock spell can no longer leap from an enemy outside of an anti-magic zone into an enemy standing in an anti-magic zone
 Magic throws and smashes now break Parry/Dodge
 Magic Smash correctly scores on par with regular Smash
 Enemies that strike at a melee arc now always animate attacking the 'center' tile only
 Mind-controlled enemies can now be ordered to move out of mist tiles created by Smoke Screen (instead of them failing to move and the action terminating)
 Fixed a bug with flourish points being awarded too early but the pips indicating progress towards flourish pips drawing by way of the 'correct' math. This could cause the player to go from 4 to 5 pips and NOT see an increase in flourish points (on account of it having been awarded earlier in the pip progression)
 Flourish moves will now generally NOT increment flourish pips (in the past they were causing the pips to move but not progress to be tracked). Flourish moves that drop damaging hazards (Flourish Familiar, Flourish Brambles, Flourish Earthquake) still give flourish pips
 Hero defending against more damage than their defense stat in one turn now properly lowers defense if the player ALSO did hit an enemy that turn
 Mastery Bonus Objectives for the Speed Trials are now awarded so long as you defeated all enemies and does NOT require getting at least a Bronze medal
 Tooltips that show enemy status now indicate Prone (instead of Staggered) if the enemy is prone
 Fixed tooltips on withered speed saplings so player can get a tooltip over the withered plant telling them what turn it could have been acquired.
 Hero Attacks that do more than 1 point of damage now can earn more than 1 point of focus / score streak / flourish pips provided they hit an enemy with enough HP. Example: If player has something that makes their charge do 2 extra damage (up to 3 total) and they hit an enemy with 2 HP remaining, they'll gain 2 focus, 2 flourish pips, and gain x2 score streak.
 Enhanced-damage attacks also have increased score values so that the attack scores proportional to the dmg done (usually +10 or +15 per extra damaged depending on the base move). Whereas doing 'excess' damage to an enemy doesn't gain bonus streak multiplier/focus/flourish, a move is scored at full value regardless of the enemy's hp (Example: A 4-dmg slash against an enemy with 2hp will only advance your score streak x2 but that action will get scored as a 40 points slash).
 Staff Flourishes that do more that 1 damage in a single impact now have those hits that are >1 dmg score +10 points per damage above 1 and adjust focus and streak if target had hp to reduce
 Fixed Battle Meditation so you now only get your spell cooldowns reduced if you did indeed pass your turn defending against nothing instead of just "any time you stay put regardless of what you defend against" This also should fix the HUD indicator for when Battle Meditation (and by extension Empowered Strike, which has the same setup conditions) show their preview highlights.
 Fast enemies update their plans based on a new decoy (that is, a non-flourish decoy thrown off your current position) during their fast actions (aka when you're taking your momentum actions) instead only noticing decoys if you thrown them as the top of the turn.
 Hero keeps defeat animation during scorescreen instead of standing back up
 Fixed some timing issues with exploding enemies
 Misc glitchy animations fixed for hero and archers
 Rollover sounds for the Campfire submenu should halt each other so moving with the mouse/tab key won't cause cascade of sounds. This also now applies to the staff select sounds (if you rapidly select different staff options, each new 'equipped' sound will halt all others)

notes.title: Quarterstaff Released
notes.content:
Happy Quarterstaff Release day! 

As of this morning, Quarterstaff has officially been released with a quarter of the Early Access price. Take advantage of this discount - it's for a limited time only!  

If you participated in the playtest, please accept our sincerest thanks! We're so grateful to Steam for providing this service, as it yielded incredible feedback results. There still may be some bugs to fix, but we're way ahead of where we'd be otherwise. The playtest has been deactivated for now - there will be further announcements if we have another to test any features.   

Our developers have worked devotedly through December to make sure our game is as good as it can be for release today. However, development will continue until Quarterstaff has the art and content it deserves!  

Over the next few months, we have a few goals in mind before we can say the game is fully completed: 

- Continue creating and adding beautiful art to flesh out all areas of the game
- Refine the main progression story 
- Complete the story for the three unreleased areas of the game 
- Add achievements (yay!) 

We plan to update the build on a monthly basis (at minimum!) if not more. There's plenty of work to be done, and the game is changing and growing daily. 

We're so glad you've decided to join us on this journey. We're looking forward to your feedback, or hearing about any incredible multiplier streaks you managed to pull off! 

Happy New Year!  

The Team at Generic Lake Monster
